items.title: There's a happiness gap between young people in Quebec and in the rest of Canada
items.description: Joshua Bujold, an upbeat psychology student in his first semester at Montreal's Dawson College, was taken aback to find out that happiness among young Canadians has plunged.

items.title: Transport Canada probing plane crash near Ontario city
items.description: Transport Canada is investigating a small plane crash that occurred on Friday near Orillia's Chris Hadfield Airport, with police saying the pilot survived.

items.title: Food prices spiked in November, says StatCan in latest inflation report
items.description: Grocery prices in Canada increased an average of 4.7 per cent in November compared to a year earlier, according to the latest Consumer Price Index.

items.title: ‘A normal thing now': Canadian family says extortion gang is preying on them
items.description: After their house in Caledon, Ont., was shot at last week, the Mands are speaking out about Canada's extortion problem, saying police and politicians are not doing enough.

Construction to Begin on New Eriksdale Emergency Department in New Year
Nova Scotia teams up with federal government to build hundreds of new homes
items.description: The Nova Scotia government says work will soon begin on hundreds of new affordable homes, with the majority slated for Shannon Park in Dartmouth.

items.title: SIU investigates after man killed in gunfire exchange with police in Welland
items.description: Ontario's police watchdog is investigating after a 26-year-old man was shot and killed by police in Welland.

items.title: You Nearly Missed: Molly Grace makes her Vancouver debut at the Fox Cabaret
items.description: The Nashville artist is touring in support of her new album, Blush.

items.title: B.C. watchdog to investigate after woman struck by Surrey police vehicle
items.description: British Columbia's police watchdog has been called in to investigate after a woman was hit late Sunday by an officer's vehicle.
